    fc_mpa=41.37, fy_mpa=344.74,
    Lb_m=9.144, Lh_m=9.144,          # unbraced lengths (b-axis / h-axis)
    # demands (LRFD)
    Pu_kN=6672.3,
    Mb_kNm=2440.5, Mh_kNm=0.0,
    Vb_kN=400.3,   Vh_kN=0.0,
    # optional
    Asr_mm2=0.0, Fysr_mpa=414.0, ri_mm=0.0, shear_span_to_depth=None,
)
